description: Section 15 of Shem Tov ibn Shaprut's Even Boḥan (a refutation of the polemical arguments of the convert Alfonso of Valladolid), containing citations of the Aramaic Gzar-dina de-Yeshu (Toledot Yeshu, "Pilate" recension) on fol. 133r; used as an indirect textual witness to the Aramaic text in Bohak's edition. The portion of the text comprising Bohak's partial edition begins in line 14 on the left side of folio 1. (Information from Gideon Bohak, The Sentencing of Jesus (Gzar-dina de-Yeshu), 40–41, 277.)
description_he: טקסט ספרותי בעברית. מוחזק בספריית קיימברידג'.
